description:
Seen once in mix ci on a loaded machine (defk-9p6.13 worktree, three benchmark agents running, load ~7 on 12 cores), seed 429407:

  1) test the runtime contract no clause matching after yields raises, and the bits built so far are freed (Defk.MultiClauseTest)
     test/multi_clause_test.exs:394
     assert %{frames_live: 0} = K.__defk_stats__()
     right: %{yields: 49, frames_live: 1, promotions: 2}

The next three runs of the file and the next full mix ci passed. Probably the frame is freed by a resource destructor that has not run yet when the assertion reads the stats (a race, like defk-vvy); the test may need to wait/poll for frames_live to reach 0 rather than assert at once.

comments.text: From the defk-fr7 stress runs (2026-10-11, load 35-180): the same frames_live-read-before-destructor pattern also hits BitstringHelperTest 'the accumulator survives yields inside the inlined helper' (frames_live 2, twice), RaiseCleanupTest 'a raise after alloc frees every owned buffer' (twice), and probably BitstringTest 'a process killed mid-build frees the buffer' (3 failures, message not read). MultiClauseTest (this ticket) failed in 2 of 11 runs.

title: Flaky under load: multi_clause_test 'no clause matching after yields raises, and the bits built so far are freed' saw frames_live: 1
